tool_args.rationale: The branch probe identified the subcritical law, but its highest gradient was 2.35, below the proposed onset at 2.50–2.68. The trajectory batch is the only remaining relevant probe on the menu. Observations above onset at nonzero input would distinguish a smooth continuation from the proposed additional sink.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the fitted subcritical saturation-and-sink law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all seven rows to rounding precision, but none of those rows can test whether it continues above the proposed threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the full supercritical siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Every measured gradient is below the proposed threshold range, so the threshold and avalanche strength are unidentifiable.
It does not measure the response across the proposed gradient threshold.
